newsitem.title: USA: Lexmark sees disappointing revenues, stock falls.
newsitem.headline: Lexmark sees disappointing revenues, stock falls.

text.p: Lexmark International Group Inc., a maker of printers and related products, said Wednesday it expects disappointing first-quarter revenues, sparking a sell-off in its stock
The stock fell $3.875 to $23.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.

Lexmark said quarterly revenues would grow from the $588 million reported a year ago but not as much as analysts' forecasts, due to price cuts, unfavourable foreign exchange rates and the company's exit from the keyboard business.
But the Lexington, Ky.-based company said operating income and net income would meet analysts' expectations.
First-quarter results are scheduled for release April 21.
